explanation: The theorem is specific to TauCeti's own definitions: the type B spin carrier, rootSubgroupIntegralCoordinateMap, rootIntMatrix, GeneralLinear.tangentMatrix, HopfIdeal.quotientLieHom, derivationComp and gaTangentLinearEquiv. Its proof reduces to the library's own lemma `tangentMatrix_derivationComp_kostantRootSubgroupCoordinateMap`. Mathlib has no Kostant root subgroup coordinate maps, no tangent-matrix API for general linear group schemes, and no Hopf-ideal quotient Lie homomorphism. I did not grep the Mathlib sources, so this rests on my knowledge of Mathlib. I found no declaration that carries this content.
